body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Belkin demonstrated its Washable Mouse during the CES 2008. It is water-resistant mouse that can survive spills and can be hand-washed under the faucet to stay clean and disinfected.
< AVING Special Report Team for ‘CES 2008’: Publisher and Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Rose Kim, Alliyah Seo, Joshua Shim, Li Coffee, Brain Park >
